comment: Findings against crates that the Wasmtime C API library links, and that
pkg/contrib cannot resolve by bumping the pin.  check-lock-audit.py fails
the audit on any other linked finding.  A finding outside the linked graph
needs no entry here; it is reported and ignored.
The version is part of the key, so a pin bump forces this file to be
reviewed again rather than carrying an acceptance forward silently.

allow.reason: Linked through rand 0.10.1, which wasmtime-wasi uses to seed guest randomness. A yank is not an advisory: no RustSec record applies to this version in the audited database. The Wasmtime 48.0.8 archive is vendored and its lock still names chacha20 0.10.0, so it cannot be updated independently of the source pin.

Linked by the Wasmtime 48.0.8 C API even with component-model, component-model-async and wasi-http disabled. RUSTSEC-2026-0386 concerns safe AsyncFd constructors accepting AsRawFd without guaranteeing a valid, owned and unchanged descriptor. All 245 linked package source trees other than Tokio, including Wasmtime, contain no AsyncFd callers; Tokio's own AsyncFd implementation is not used by this build. The source archive is vendored, so this exact version cannot be updated independently. Recheck reachability and remove this exception at the next pin bump.

Linked by the Wasmtime 48.0.8 C API through crates/cache (zstd = { version = "0.13.0" in crates/cache/Cargo.toml). RUSTSEC-2026-0403 concerns uninitialized memory exposure via zstd::stream::write::Decoder on a legacy (v0.4-v0.7) frame. The wasmtime-cache crate only calls zstd::decode_all and zstd::encode_all (crates/cache/src/lib.rs:258,267), which the advisory explicitly lists as unaffected. The source archive is vendored, so this exact version cannot be updated independently of the source pin.

Linked by the Wasmtime 48.0.8 C API through crates/cache (zstd = { version = "0.13.0" in crates/cache/Cargo.toml). RUSTSEC-2026-0395 concerns a use-after-free with CParameter::StableInBuffer. The wasmtime-cache crate only calls zstd::decode_all and zstd::encode_all (crates/cache/src/lib.rs:258,267), which never enable StableInBuffer; encode_all sets only CompressionLevel. The source archive is vendored, so this exact version cannot be updated independently of the source pin. Recheck reachability and remove this exception at the next pin bump.

Linked by the Wasmtime 48.0.8 C API as the zstd-sys dependency of zstd-safe (zstd-safe 7.0.0 is pulled in by crates/cache via zstd = { version = "0.13.0" }). RUSTSEC-2026-0410 targets arch = ["wasm32"] only: a WebAssembly allocator shim that corrupts memory on allocation failure. The FreeUnit build targets native x86_64/aarch64, where the shim is not compiled and the affected code path is unreachable. The source archive is vendored and its Cargo.lock cannot be repaired in-tree, so this exact version cannot be updated independently of the source pin. Recheck reachability and remove this exception at the next pin bump.
